subject: Request: Backfill approval — Senior Data Engineer (internal transfer)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Backfill request: Senior Data Engineer (attrition)

Team —

Heads-up: Maya (SDE3, Infrastructure) submitted her resignation effective 4/30. Her role is critical to platform telemetry and model-serving infra; we need to backfill. Rather than open an external hire immediately, I recommend an internal transfer to refill the seat from Marcus's org (see candidate below) to preserve continuity and reduce ramp.

Quick summary:
- Vacancy: Senior Data Engineer (SDE3) on Platform Reliability — Maya's seat (attrition).
- Proposed path: Internal transfer of Anil Rao (current IC3 on Marcus's infra team) to SDE3. Marcus confirms willingness to release and provide overlap.
- Ask: Approve backfill via internal transfer and permission to extend an offer up to mid-SDE3 band (pending comp sign-off).

Why internal transfer?
- Anil has 18 months on infra stack, already owning KV cache and rollout infra — minimal ramp.
- Reduces time-to-impact and cost vs external hire.

Attachments: backfill_justification.pdf, role_description_SDE3.docx (JD).

Next steps I need from this thread:
1) Priyom — confirmation of comp band ceiling we can offer for internal transfer.
2) Neha — confirm headcount code and whether People Ops needs a formal headcount change ticket.
3) Laura — approval to proceed with internal transfer (high-level).
4) Marcus — verbal confirmation that candidate is open and handover plan is feasible.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick call if needed today.

—
Ava Chen
Manager, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill request: Senior Data Engineer (attrition)

Ava —

Thanks for the write-up. A few quick items from comp side before we sign off:
- Target band requested (range) — are you asking for SDE3 midpoint or top-of-band? You asked for "mid-SDE3"; please confirm a numeric range so I can log it.
- Current total comp for the candidate (base + target bonus + equity) so we can compare internal uplift vs promotion.
- Is this transfer expected to be a re-level (promotion) or a lateral move with different responsibilities?

I've attached comp_band_guidance.pdf — it has current nominal ranges and the internal promotion policy. If you can drop the candidate's current comp and desired target (or a band), I will run it by Finance and provide a clear approval threshold.

If you prefer, I can pre-approve up to 10% above midpoint for internal transfers that meet impact criteria; anything above needs Laura's sign-off.

—
Priyom Das
Total Rewards Partner
Redwood Inference
Attachment: comp_band_guidance.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill request: Senior Data Engineer (attrition)

Ava/Neha —

Confirming Anil Rao is willing to transfer to Platform Reliability. I spoke with him this morning; he sees the work as a strong growth opportunity and is prepared to move after a 3-week overlap plan. Highlights of handover plan:
- Week 1–2: paired runbooks and shadowing on SRE on-call and KV cache ops.
- Week 3: Anil leads two incident postmortems with this team, Marcus will still own primary on-call for critical incidents.
- Knowledge artifacts: runbooks, dashboard ownership, and a migration checklist (attached: handover_plan.md).

We will backfill Marcus's seat internally (SDE2) within 8–10 weeks; we are comfortable with the temporary gap.

—
Marcus Lin
Senior Engineering Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference
Attachment: handover_plan.md
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill request: Senior Data Engineer (attrition)

Thanks — a few operational checks from People Ops: 
1) Please confirm headcount code (req #) or if this is a straight reassign of the existing req. If new headcount needed, I will open a headcount change and notify Finance.
2) Budget impact: attach budget_impact.xlsx with FY26 impact (please complete section A).
3) Offer logistics: we use the internal transfer template for DocuSign — link below. If compensation is within the pre-approved threshold from Priyom, I can prepare the offer and route for signatures.

DocuSign template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/transfer-offer-template

Please add the completed budget_impact.xlsx when you reply.

—
Neha Kapoor
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
Attachment: budget_impact.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backfill request: Senior Data Engineer (attrition)

Team —

I approve proceeding with the internal transfer of Anil Rao into the Senior Data Engineer role, pending Priyom's comp sign-off (explicit numeric band).
Conditions:
- Offer ceiling: up to mid-SDE3 band (Priyom to confirm midpoint number by EOD Wednesday).
- People Ops to prepare transfer offer and route via DocuSign once comp is confirmed.
- Marcus to guarantee the 3-week overlap and deliver the handover artifacts.

Neha — please open the headcount ticket (if needed) and copy Finance. Once Priyom posts the final approved band, Neha can issue the offer.

Good work coordinating — this preserves velocity for the platform team.

—
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
